dedupe_keys.name: updated stable continental region earthquake catalogue

description: This repository publishes an updated earthquake-event catalogue for stable continental regions. The CSV combines events in the EPRI 2012 catalogue with Reviewed ISC Bulletin observations selected for Fennoscandian analogue domains. Its README documents date, epicentre, expected moment magnitude, magnitude standard deviation, domain and observation-source fields. It distinguishes EPRI rows from ISC additions and merged entries, and says the thesis describes magnitude harmonisation, duplicate removal and exclusion of events explicitly marked anthropogenic by ISC. A seismic modeller could use the events as input to probabilistic hazard calculations or compare source-zone choices for Finland. The geographic selection is broader than Finland but the exact included domains and event period were not checked because the CSV and thesis were not downloaded. The repository licence states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for this work. Rights for the underlying EPRI and ISC records were not verified and may differ. This review checked public metadata and documentation, not the event values or completeness of the harmonisation. Its direct simulation use is sensitivity testing of earthquake-source assumptions in probabilistic seismic hazard models.
licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the repository work; underlying EPRI/ISC source-data rights require separate review.
